title: Sign Betting for Misspecified Regression: Variance Adaptivity and Optimal Approximation
abstract: arXiv:2610.20903v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study bounded regression under model misspecification, evaluating a function $f$ by its $L_1(P_X)$ distance to the conditional mean $\eta(x)=\mathbb{E}[Y\mid X=x]$, rather than the standard $L_2(P_X)$. This $L_1$ metric is natural for downstream decision problems such as bandits and reinforcement learning. We analyze the min--max estimator of Baraud & Maillard (2025), which we call \emph{sign-betting regression}. Our main results show that sign-betting regression achieves high-probability $L_1$ oracle inequalities under misspecification. Under realizability, our bound adapts to the average conditional variance and recovers the variance-adaptive rate of Li et al. (2026). We further characterize the optimal universal approximation factor for proper learning by showing that sign betting achieves factor 3, while no proper learner can satisfy a distribution-free, high-probability $L_1$ oracle inequality with a universal approximation facto

translated_title: 面向误设回归的符号投注方法：方差自适应与最优逼近
translated_abstract: 我们研究模型误设下的有界回归问题，通过函数 $f$ 与条件均值 $\eta(x)=\mathbb{E}[Y\mid X=x]$ 之间的 $L_1(P_X)$ 距离来评估函数，而非采用标准的 $L_2(P_X)$ 距离。这一 $L_1$ 度量对多臂老虎机和强化学习等下游决策问题而言是自然的。我们分析了 Baraud 与 Maillard（2025）提出的极小极大估计器，并将其称为“符号投注回归”。我们的主要结果表明，符号投注回归在模型误设情形下能够实现高概率的 $L_1$ 预言机不等式。在可实现性条件下，我们的界能够自适应于平均条件方差，并恢复了 Li 等人（2026）的方差自适应速率。我们进一步刻画了恰当学习中最优的普适逼近因子，证明符号投注方法可以达到因子 3，而没有任何恰当学习器能够在无分布假设、高概率的 $L_1$ 预言机不等式下满足更小的普适逼近因子（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文证明符号投注回归在模型误设下可实现高概率的 $L_1$ 预言机不等式，其误差界自适应于平均条件方差，并证明其对恰当学习所能达到的普适逼近因子 3 是最优的。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that sign-betting regression achieves high-probability $L_1$ oracle inequalities under model misspecification with bounds that adapt to the average conditional variance, and establishes that its universal approximation factor of 3 is optimal for proper learning.
